answer: Force every ID to hold a live 5 Mbps uplink against 3 regional beacons for 10 minutes each epoch; shared pipes choke when the traffic ripple arrives. Beacons fan out through a nebula of ASNs, and any cluster whose routes collapse onto one mesa draws a single payout. Renting that dedicated path runs about $12/month, so spinning up 100 clones costs roughly $1,200/month and scales linearly.
